verdict.rationale: cubic reacts automatically to certain built-in events (new PR opened, force-push, clean PR approval) and lets teams configure review behavior via cubic.yaml, but there's no evidence of a general user-defined rules engine that triggers arbitrary custom actions on arbitrary events — automation is limited to cubic's own predefined review triggers. missing for 10: a documented rules/trigger system where users define custom event conditions and custom actions, evidence of webhook/event subscriptions beyond PR lifecycle, and independent confirmation of this automation working reliably.
